title: Alex Eala’s Asian Games opener moved indoors after rain delay

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala’s opening match at the Asian Games 2026 women’s singles tennis tournament has been delayed and moved indoors due to weather disruptions in Aichi-Nagoya. Eala is now scheduled to begin her campaign no earlier than 4:15 p.m. at Indoor Court C of the Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. The mixed doubles first-round match preceding hers was still ongoing as of posting.
